tonight.headline: Tuten should play — put him back over Kamara before 19:15
body: Bad news first. Garrett Wilson missed Thursday's practice too, still in the concussion protocol; ESPN's Rich Cimini calls a Week 9 return unlikely. Kamara was only limited Thursday with his back. Kyler Murray is out Monday, so Carson Wentz throws to Jefferson.

The good news reverses this morning's call. ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reported at about 15:50 CDMX that Tuten 'should be' good for Baltimore barring a pregame setback. Put Tuten back in the RB slot before 19:15, and move Kamara into Wilson's FLEX slot (Diggs is already at WR). As the lineup stands, AVIATO project 121.7 against Talla Metralla's 132.9.

case.label: Why the morning call flips
case.body: This morning's bench rested on a pattern: all 27 Coen-era players with three DNPs sat (SI 5 Nov). A named insider report outranks a pattern. Fowler's post came after the 09:00 brief (NBC/Rotoworld 21:50Z; ClutchPoints 22:03Z), and ESPN's 15.4 already assumed he plays.

case.label: The safety net
case.body: If Tuten is on the inactive list at 17:45 CDMX, put Kamara back in the RB slot and Allgeier into the FLEX. If nobody looks at 17:45 and Tuten is a surprise inactive, the slot scores zero — that is the cost of following the report.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten is inactive tonight, or he plays and Kamara outscores him in Week 9 (archive).
